cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Whether I broke the window is outside this repair meeting's scope.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let's hold a responsibility meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. After the repairs. We need a safe venue.
